key_insight: VN-GraphGG simulates 2D grain growth by evolving grain areas with the von Neumann–Mullins law on a graph and then reconstructing the microstructure with a trained GNN.
engineering_relevance: It offers a fast, topology-aware alternative to phase-field grain-growth simulation and lets kinetic coefficients change without retraining the reconstruction model.
method: Represent the polycrystal as a graph with grain nodes and junction nodes.
Evolve grain areas using von Neumann–Mullins kinetics on the grain graph.
Use a graph neural network to reconstruct the 2D microstructure and handle grain disappearance/neighborhood changes via postprocessing.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports accurate VN kinetics and coarsening statistics, with significant speedup over phase-field simulations, including an abnormal grain growth example.
watch_item: As a 2D graph-based surrogate, performance may depend on robust reconstruction when topological events are frequent or when extending to more complex physics.
paper_title: VN-GraphGG: von Neumann--Mullins--based graph grain growth simulation
